candidate.title: The Kubernetes clients used by Cilium Agent and Cilium Operator now have separately configurable rate limits
candidate.text: The Kubernetes clients used by Cilium Agent and Cilium Operator now have separately configurable rate limits. The default rate limit for Cilium Operator K8s clients has been increased to 100 QPS/200 Burst. To configure the rate limit for Cilium Operator, use the `--operator-k8s-client-qps` and `--operator-k8s-client-burst` flags or the corresponding Helm values.

evidence.excerpt:
* The Kubernetes clients used by Cilium Agent and Cilium Operator now have separately configurable
  rate limits. The default rate limit for Cilium Operator K8s clients has been increased to
  100 QPS/200 Burst. To configure the rate limit for Cilium Operator, use the
  `--operator-k8s-client-qps` and `--operator-k8s-client-burst` flags or the corresponding
  Helm values.
